description: Least-privilege defaults for the Taskly desktop shell. Core window controls apply to the main window only. The embedded Taskly web app is remote content and deliberately receives no IPC access; the tray, its menu and window close-to-tray behaviour are handled entirely in Rust, so no core:tray:* / core:menu:* permissions are listed here (those only gate JavaScript-driven tray APIs, which the shell does not use).
